thread:
oliver: Quick design check on the onboarding quickstart banner + tiny sample-project cards. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz/onboard-quickstart-v2

maya: :eyes: First impression good. Concern: banner pushes checklist below the fold on small screens. Maybe make banner dismissible with cookie so returning users don't see it.

sam: Agree re dismissible banner. Also the sample cards need clearer affordance for 'use project' vs 'preview'. Right now both are similar buttons and people might click the wrong one.

joan: A11y report from aria_bot: 2 images without alt text, missing visible focus for card actions, contrast issue on the muted helper copy. Recommend visible focus ring and aria-labels for the preview button.

aria_bot: Auto-a11y summary: contrast fail on helper text (ratio 3.8:1), 2 images missing alt, focusable element order mismatch on mobile. More: https://a11y.report/redwood/quickstart-v2

oliver: Thanks. Proposed changes: make banner closable, reduce banner height on mobile, swap preview to an icon-only secondary action with aria-label, primary action labeled 'Use this sample'. Also make checklist 2 steps visible + 'more options' link. Thoughts?

maya: Sounds good. For analytics, track banner dismiss and sample-card 'use' clicks. We'll need these events in the experiment.

sam: I'll prototype the icon-only preview and adjust button styles. Will also add visible focus styles.

joan: I'll patch the a11y issues and add checks to the suite. Will also add alt text guidelines for thumbnails.

oliver: Owners: sam -> prototype + mock, joan -> a11y fixes/tests, maya -> analytics events. Please react with :thumbsup: when taken.

sam: :thumbsup: will deliver a mock by Thursday.

joan: :thumbsup: will open a11y PR today.

maya: :thumbsup: I'll add events to the backlog and flag analytics.

oliver: Great, we'll review on Friday's design sync.
